from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DeferredTaxAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Deferred income tax asset value reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    asset_value: float | None = Field(description="Deferred income tax asset value at reporting end")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    asset_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the report for the asset")
    initial_balance: float | None = Field(description="Deferred income tax asset value at beginning of period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    deferred_tax_asset_records: list[DeferredTaxAssetRecord]
